purpose: Implementation roadmap for turning the current Datastar + Effect prototype into a coherent server-driven framework.

tasks.title: Define the framework architecture baseline
tasks.goal: Decide and document what ts-star is: a low-level SDK, a framework, or a layered system with both.
deliverables: Updated README matching actual src files

tasks.title: Lock down Datastar protocol semantics
tasks.goal: Make Datastar response behavior impossible to misuse and aligned with the actual browser runtime.
deliverables: Direct response helpers with safe status behavior

tasks.title: Design the backend-state and CQRS programming model
tasks.goal: Define the default app model: backend state as truth, commands mutate, queries/render streams patch current views.
deliverables: Guidelines for fat morph vs targeted patch

tasks.title: Make the runtime Effect-native
tasks.goal: Move from helper functions around Effect to a real Effect architecture with Layers, services, Scope, and typed errors.

tasks.title: Create end-to-end type contracts
tasks.goal: Tie signal definitions, request decoding, route/action helpers, and patches to one source of truth.

tasks.title: Define the HTML and templating boundary
tasks.goal: Keep HTML generation simple while allowing external renderers and preserving Datastar attribute ordering semantics.
deliverables: Decision on JSX vs hyperscript vs renderer adapters

tasks.title: Establish the signal policy and scoping model
tasks.goal: Prevent signals from becoming hidden client-side application state.
deliverables: Examples rewritten to reflect backend-source-of-truth defaults

tasks.title: Build realtime live-query architecture
tasks.goal: Replace event-delta-first realtime with reconnect-safe live queries that render current backend state.

tasks.title: Define request lifecycle, security, and boundaries
tasks.goal: Make server-driven UI safe by default: CSRF, sessions, auth context, request limits, aborts, and untrusted signals.

tasks.title: Design validation and error UX
tasks.goal: Give applications a clear way to return validation errors, action failures, and fatal errors without ad-hoc responses.

tasks.title: Add observability and real browser testing
tasks.goal: Prove the framework against the actual Datastar runtime and make request/SSE behavior inspectable.
deliverables: Runtime tests for direct responses and SSE streams

tasks.title: Define extensibility and public API stabilization
tasks.goal: Create extension points without turning the framework into a plugin-heavy frontend framework clone.

tasks.title: Build reference examples and documentation
tasks.goal: Show the intended programming model through realistic apps, not just low-level helper snippets.

tasks.title: Prepare performance and deployment story
tasks.goal: Make deployment choices explicit: compression, caching, self-hosted Datastar, reverse proxy behavior, and stream scalability.
